integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: Connect shadow to third-party services. Each toggle is reversible; closing an integration hides its UI affordances and disables its Tauri commands.

feishu.title: Feishu / Lark
feishu.description: Enables document_publish_feishu and the 'Publish to Feishu' button on /document/:taskId. With the toggle off, document_save still works (the sheet stays in local git) but no share URL is created.
feishu.runtimeNote: Runtime toggle (FEISHU_ENABLED). The build-time gate (FEISHU_APP_ID + FEISHU_APP_SECRET env vars on the Tauri backend) is separate — without those the integration can't make API calls even when enabled.

computerUse.gateDescription: Mouse + keyboard actions require the gate to be open. Screenshots work regardless.
computerUse.gateWarning: Closing the gate is reversible; reopening requires explicit user action. The agent can still request screenshots while closed.
computerUse.screenshotDescription: Captures the primary monitor via xcap. Returns PNG bytes rendered inline below.
computerUse.noScreenshotYet: No screenshot yet. Click "Capture screenshot" above.
computerUse.noteWindows: Windows hosts get the full element-based path via UIA — click_ui_by_name, read_ui_text, etc. — see the 4 Windows-only cu_* commands in lib.rs.
computerUse.noteOther: macOS / Linux use coordinate-based mouse + keyboard via enigo. Coordinates break when windows resize or move; prefer the Windows path when available.
computerUse.noteMcp: For agent-driven use, the cu_* primitives are wrapped as MCP tools by a future change. The MCP wrapper lives in feishu_mcp's pattern — same substrate as diencephalon.
